activity.role: LDPR leader and State Duma politician
activity.notes: Zhirinovsky never ruled the Russian Federation. He led the LDPR from 18 April 1992 until his death on 6 April 2022 and served for decades in the State Duma, including as a parliamentary faction leader and deputy chairman. ATLAS therefore records bounded national political activity, not a presidential or sovereign term.

sources.title: Zhirinovsky Vladimir Volfovich — State Duma
